title: OL-20261122-2: Re-grade Unlearn entries when new reviews pile up
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** GET https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/api/review-queue.json returns a non-empty queue
**Done check:** grep:instances/unlearn/worker/evidence.js::export async function regrade
**Status:** open

The evidence loop flags entries with 3 or more unreviewed new reviews at /api/review-queue.json; re-grading an entry (reading the new reviews into its grade and marking leads reviewed) is not yet automated.
